native_runtime_identity.scope: All archived E55 runtime/native source files byte-identical; only Makefile adds the new recipe test. New helper/benchmark files are separately recorded, not inference implementation changes.

group_equivalence.scope: Actual generated profile patterns versus original individual language; Python regex differential corpus plus separate real OS tests. Candidate remains experimental.

aborted_runs.scope: Aborted during warmup; not pooled into formal180
Aborted during warmup; not pooled into formal180

method.ordering: Case and mode rotation/reversal, serial unsanitized; all correctness jobs completed before timing
method.target: All modes explicitly use macOS26.0/C++17/O2, same compiler/SDK; actual triple/macro check in E56 retained
method.baseline: Original E55 per-pattern profile remains the default; grouped_on is a separately built experimental CLI with the same other sources/permissions and logging.
method.cache: PCH created fresh inside the existing private sandbox tmp for every task, all cold generation, compile/link/run/traps/cleanup included; no persistent/shared cache or skipped compiler validation.
method.metrics: Whole CLI process plus inner total and per-compiler wait4 measurements; inside_other includes program execution and script/observer work, not pure scheduling. PCH file bytes sampled before cleanup, not RSS.
method.clock_guard: Parent controlled by process-lifetime caffeinate -i only; no global power setting changes. Both CLOCK_MONOTONIC and Python mach_absolute perf_counter recorded; abs gap>=100ms aborts whole run. Earlier interrupted warmups retained. Exact earlier pause/clock cause unresolved.
method.source_provenance: No production runtime source edit. Candidate builder source/patch and hash manifest recorded; Makefile adds recipe test only.
method.privacy: Synthetic fixtures/local HTTP choices only; no model inference/cloud or exported caches/binaries/logs.

limits: PCH setup may cost more for single translation units; only workload-specific measured net benefits can be claimed. New tasks do not prove arbitrary project macro/ABI equivalence.
A shared common header must be valid as an early prefix; recipe fixes C++17/O2 and requires an explicit deployment target. It is an optional build recipe, not an automatic agent tool change.
Grouped candidate has the same regex language and no new grants but may regress; its results are not pooled with PCH gains or treated as default improvement.
Default sensitive-file/network/IPC/parent-environment limitations remain E53/E55. No VM/universal DLP or Linux/Windows backend is introduced.
Small-n min/max are descriptive; no p95/p99, exact code-signing attribution, process-RSS or model-KV benefit measured.

decision.default_profile: Keep individual-pattern E55 profile; no production security-rule edit
decision.grouped_candidate: Do not enable by default: mixed paired signs and large regressions; full candidate source builder/OS tests retained
decision.private_pch: Provide explicit per-task recipe for repeated common headers; single-file cold overhead remains negative; no automatic compiler flags or persistent cache
